description: Defines a SwiftUI View called ContextUsageBar for visualizing the usage of tokens within a specific context, with customizable width, height, and color indicators based on usage percentage.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for displaying a bar indicating token usage within a context, with color coding based on usage levels.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the usage fraction, clamped between 0 and 1, based on used tokens and total context tokens.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of tokens used as an integer, or nil if total context tokens or used tokens are zero.

methods.name: tint
methods.description: Determines the color of the usage bar based on the percentage of tokens used.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides an accessibility label indicating the usage percentage or an unknown status.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Constructs the visual representation of the usage bar with filled and stroked rounded rectangles.
